messages:
leah_marketing: Quick ask: product launch slide deck needs a "mini bench pack" for the marketing repo. Scope: demo interaction (streaming + function call), coldstart vs warmed workers, quantized vs fp16, and one long-context probe. Need artifacts + tiny sanitized prompt pack by COB Tuesday.

drew_runtime: Clarify models and traffic shape? Also want to know if you need per-token GPU-ms or just end-to-end.

leah_marketing: Models: open-3b-quant, open-7b-quant, open-7b-fp16. Traffic: human-typing shaped (burst-ish) — 3 users, each 3 short turns (~35 tokens), then 1 long probe (1800 tokens). Include per-token GPU-ms if available, plus p50/p90/p95/p99 and a short README with exact CLI and env.

sam_devtools: I can provide a small harness snippet; it simulates typing with random inter-char delays and supports streaming chunk thresholds. Paste: ```json
{
  "users":3,
  "short_turns":3,
  "short_avg_tokens":35,
  "long_probe_tokens":1800,
  "typing_delay_ms_range":[40,120],
  "stream_chunk_ms":150,
  "function_call":true
}
```

drew_runtime: Good — well run a quick smoke on quantized variants now, then full sweep including fp16 tomorrow morning. We'll attach perf.jsonl, metrics.csv (1s), KV cache hit stats, and a README that includes the harness commit SHA.

iza_eval: I'll assemble a 28-prompt fidelity suite focusing on function-call schema correctness and a few coherence checks on the long probe. Output will be a pass/fail table and flagged prompt IDs for repro. ETA next morning.

benchbot: queued run id=rb-2026-3610001111-01 targets=[open-3b-quant,open-7b-quant], profile=typing_demo, expected_duration=20m. Artifacts will be uploaded to s3://redwood-bench/3610001111_01/ when done.

leah_marketing: Thanks — please attach sanitized_prompts.json and tag @leah_marketing when artifacts land. If any quantized variant fails the eval, well default demo to the 3b quant baseline and call out the tradeoffs in slide notes. :thumbsup:
